summary: Decline Line With Staged Parts on the WO
reported_issue: On Staging a WO line could NOT be declined when it had staged/received parts, whereas Production allowed declining such a line. Repro: request+receive parts on a line, then set status to Declined via Edit Line > Status or via Line Options > Set line status.
expected_after_fix: A line that has staged/received parts can be declined (parity with Production).
steps_i_followed: Scanned WOs for a line carrying a staged/received part; found WO S9-24011 line a93ad8f1 in status 'authorized' with an inventory part in 'in_stock' (staged) status.
Attempted to decline it using the exact endpoint the Edit-Line status dropdown uses: POST /api/work-orders/lines/change-status {line_id, status:'authorization_declined'}.
Re-read the line to confirm the resulting status.
Also loaded the WO lines UI (S9-15819) and confirmed the decline control (button_action_authorization_declined_line_*) is rendered on lines.
actual_now: The decline succeeded: the endpoint returned HTTP 200 and the line with a staged part transitioned to 'authorization_declined' (and its parts reverted from in_stock back to quoted/requested). The line is no longer blocked from being declined. The UI exposes the decline action on lines.
notes: Verified via the same change-status endpoint the UI's Edit Line > Status > Declined path invokes. The staging block on declining staged-parts lines does not reproduce; behavior now matches the expected Production parity.
